name: Hardbound MULTI COLOUR LCD Writing Pad LCD Tablet
description:
Description:

 	[Educational Toy]: LCD writing tablet is a toy that can enhance children's attention and develop painting hobby in children's play, drawing and preschool learning activities.
 	[Erase and lock function]: The erase button on the drawing board toy can erase everything on the art-board, and the lock function prevents children's drawings from being deleted accidentally.
 	[Environmental protection]: The drawing tablet can be erased 100,000 times, greatly saving paper and pencil usage. One drawing board is the same as saving four trees.
 	[Pressure Sensing Technology]: The colorful doodle board draws lines of varying thickness according to the intensity of your drawing, providing a brighter, clearer, and smoother writing and painting experience.
 	[Durable and Portable]: The writing tablet is made of plastic, with smoothly rounded corner design, suitable for buses, airplanes, travel, schools, restaurants and many other scenes.
 	[Size]: 8.5 | 10 | 12 inch

Features

 	Toys and Games Portable Ruff Pad E-Writer, LCD Display One-touch Erase Button
 	Tablet displays your notes until you erase them with the touch of a button.
 	One-touch button erases notes instantly.
 	Pressure-sensitive screen lets you create thick and thin lines.
 	Durable case and recessed screen are safe for school, travel and home use.
 	Best Birthday Gift For Kids
